steps.domain_action: The Deep exists as the unmarked void before any distinction.
The potential for connection branches into the possibility of a thread or a gap.
The shuttle moves forward to establish a thread between distinctions.
The thread is affirmed as a successful connection.
The thread is chained to the next distinction in the sequence.
The shuttle moves backward to test the stability of the connection.
The gap is affirmed as a failed connection or absence.
The thread and gap rejoin to form the definitive topological state.
The system holds the paradox of connection and disconnection simultaneously.
The weaver recognizes themselves in the weave, establishing self-reference.
The tapestry is fixed as a permanent record of the woven structure.
The Ouroboric Knot closes the system, defining the boundary of the topology.
